name: NYC long-stay asking-price screening benchmark
population: Positive-priced NYC non-hotel listings with advertised minimum >=30 nights
intended_use: Historical asking-price comparison and screening with contemporaneous property/location attributes
test_unit: One price-independent hash-selected listing per account unseen in all raw prior snapshots
point_target: log1p advertised nightly USD, back-transformed with expm1
weighting: Inverse eligible training listing count per host, normalized to mean one
interval: Nominal80% finite-rank absolute log-residual calibration on June unseen accounts; empirical temporal coverage only
subgroup_limit: Queens private-room medianAPE32.9%; several groups n<30; see all subgroup tables
